messages:
Alex: noticed a subtle p95 regression on tiny requests after yesterday's kernel selector tweak. Host pool B only. Dash: https://dash.redwood/hostpoolB :thinking:
Ravi: what does batching look like? micro-bench?
Alex: median running-batch-size dropped 4->2. KV remote-fallbacks + smallwrite frames both up. Sample trace pasted:
```
12:05:31.100 parse 0.8ms
12:05:31.101 tokenize 2.4ms
12:05:31.104 kvcache lookup 0.5ms (miss -> 3.9ms fetch)
12:05:31.108 kernel_exec 19.0ms
12:05:31.127 grpc_writev 3.0ms (2 frames)
```
Leah: sounds like selector picked the fused kernel for model X shapes. It helps long seqs but hurts tiny seqs. Suggest short-term: add a rule to prefer lightweight kernel when p50 batch <3, and emit kernel_variant label per host.
Ravi: agree. Also add a replay test (2k 32-token reqs) to preflight for selector changes.
infra-bot: noted. Can apply soft-rollback on canary pool, confirm?
Alex: yes please. Also start RFC for adding host-preproc cost into kernel scoring (tokenize+parse+network estimate).
infra-bot: soft-rollback started and completed at 12:09:50 UTC. Metrics returning to baseline.
Alex: closing alert, moving follow-ups to RFC. Thanks :thumbsup:
